==English==

===Alternative forms===

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:wher|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*kʷ-}}

===Adverb===
{{wikidata lexeme|L59}}
{{en-adv|-}}

# {{lb|en|interrogative}} In, at or to [[what]] [[place]].
#: {{syn|en|whither|q=to which place; archaic or literary}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Where''' are you?}}
#: {{ux|en|He asked '''where''' I grew up.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Where''' are you going?}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Where''' you going?|q=''informal, 'be' verb omitted''}}
#: {{ux|en|I've forgotten '''where''' I was in this book, but it was probably around chapter four.}}
#: {{ux|en|I hardly knew '''where''' I was going.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}
# In what situation.
#: {{ux|en|'''Where''' would we be without our parents?}}
# In, at or to the place (that) or a place (that).
#: {{ux|en|Stay '''where''' you are.}}
#: {{ux|en|Go back '''where''' you came from.}}
#: {{ux|en|Let's go '''where''' it's warmer.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2013|month=July-August|author=w:Henry Petroski
|title=[http://www.americanscientist.org/issues/pub/2013/4/geothermal-energy Geothermal Energy]
|volume=101|issue=4|magazine=w:American Scientist
|passage=Energy has seldom been found '''where''' we need it when we want it. Ancient nomads, wishing to ward off the evening chill and enjoy a meal around a campfire, had to collect wood and then spend time and effort coaxing the heat of friction out from between sticks to kindle a flame. With more settled people, animals were harnessed to capstans or caged in treadmills to turn grist into meal.}}
# In, at or to any place (that); [[wherever]]; [[anywhere]].
#: {{ux|en|Please sit '''where''' you like.}}
#: {{ux|en|Their job is to go '''where''' they are called.}}
# {{lb|en|relative}} In, at or to which.
#: {{ux|en|This is the place '''where''' we first met.}}
#: {{ux|en|He is looking for a house '''where''' he can have a complete office.}}
#: {{ux|en|That's the place '''where''' we went on holiday.}}
#: {{ux|en|Here's a picture of York, '''where''' I was born.|q=non-defining}}
#: {{ux|en|Show me an example '''where''' it happened that way.}}
# {{lb|en|fused relative}} The place in, at or to which.
#: {{ux|en|He lives within five miles of '''where''' he was born.}}
#: {{ux|en|This is a photo of '''where''' I went on holiday.}}
# {{lb|en|fused relative|informal}} A situation or case in which.
#: {{ux|en|A function is '''where''' two variables are related.}}
# In a/the situation, position, case, etc. in which. <!-- some uses seem bordering on conjunction -->
#: {{ux|en|You cannot be too careful '''where''' explosives are involved.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Where''' no provision under this Act is applicable, the case shall be decided in accordance with the customary practices.}}
